annotationRationale: The solution uses distance, speed, and time relationships for each segment, after converting minutes to hours.
sourceMethod: Follows the official solution by subtracting the first two segment distances from 96 miles, then dividing by half an hour.

review.mathCheck: The three half-hour intervals satisfy (60+65+v)/2 = 96, giving v = 67 mph, choice D. The candidate correctly obtains the remaining 33.5 miles and divides by 1/2 hour.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithfully rewords MAA solution 2 on page 2, preserving its first-two-distances calculation, remaining-distance subtraction and final distance/time quotient.
review.annotationCheck: The time conversion, distance balance and average-speed calculation are explicit and sufficient. Using interval average speeds does not require constant instantaneous speed.
